title: Pass-Through Charges on Wayfare Rides: Airport Fees and Tolls
content:
Airport access fees and tolls are pass-through charges on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**: Wayfare passes them to the rider at the scheduled amounts.

## Rule

1. Airport fees and tolls are passed through only on a completed trip, as the trip's system record shows.
2. An airport fee is charged once per trip, at the amount the airport fee schedule lists for the airport, only when the trip's airport end (pickup or drop-off) is one of the trip ends the schedule lists for that airport; a trip whose airport end is not listed carries no airport fee.
3. The clause *a toll is charged once per toll facility crossed between pickup and drop-off, at the toll schedule amount for that facility, whichever direction it was crossed* is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.
4. Toll facilities the driver used on the way to the pickup are never charged to the rider.
5. Neither an airport fee nor a toll is multiplied by the busy-time multiplier or discounted by Wayfare Pass, and neither earns Pass ride credit.
6. A toll or airport fee charged when the conditions above do not hold is refunded in full, with the reason *toll not incurred* or *airport surcharge not applicable* respectively.

## Airport fee: condition and result

| Trip completed | Trip's airport end listed for that airport | Airport fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | charged once, at the scheduled amount |
| Yes | No | none; if charged, refunded in full as airport surcharge not applicable |
| No | — | none; if charged, refunded in full as airport surcharge not applicable |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A completed trip dropped off at an airport whose fee is listed for pickups only carries no airport fee there; if one was charged, it is refunded in full as *airport surcharge not applicable*.
- A toll facility the driver crossed while driving to the pickup point is never the rider's charge; if it was charged, it is refunded in full as *toll not incurred*.
- An airport fee on a completed trip is the same amount whatever the busy-time multiplier recorded at the request and whatever the rider's Wayfare Pass plan.

superseded_clauses: A toll is charged once per toll facility crossed between pickup and drop-off, at the toll_schedule amount for that facility, whichever direction it was crossed;
